summary: Alerts are thresholds on report data, so the Library makes you describe the metric from scratch. If you already have an audit that has run, the bell on its report widget is easier — it fills the metric in for you. Otherwise: we'll start one called "Alert: Broken pages go above 10" and you set the number.

steps.say: Open Alerts under Standards in the sidebar.

targetFallback.description: the "Alerts" link under Standards in the left sidebar

steps.say: Naming it "Alert: Broken pages go above 10".

targetFallback.description: the alert name field at the top of the designer

steps.say: Pick the report and metric to watch, set the threshold, then continue.

targetFallback.description: the Next button in the alert designer

steps.say: Add who should be notified, then continue.

targetFallback.description: the Next button in the alert designer

steps.say: Choose the audits it applies to, then Save.

targetFallback.description: the Save button in the alert designer
